itens.titulo: Nvidia (NVDA) Expands Nemotron As $4 Billion Texas Supply Push Meets Customer Debt Stress
itens.descricao: Nvidia (NVDA) Expands Nemotron As $4 Billion Texas Supply Push Meets Customer Debt Stress Yahoo Finance
trechos: - Nvidia (NasdaqGS:NVDA) expanded its Nemotron 3.5 open AI model lineup, adding new variants aimed at higher efficiency and performance.
- Nvidia signed a partnership with Mindbeam to tune Nemotron 3.5 models for open-source use, targeting improved inference on Nvidia hardware.
- Taiwan backed a US$4b industrial park project in Texas to reinforce Nvidia linked AI supply chains inside the United States.
- The Nemotron 3.5 expansion, Mindbeam tie up and CoreWeave stress only capture part of Nvidia's shifting AI position.
Our analysis turns up 2 warning signs (1 major) for NVIDIA as well.
For readers tracking how AI compute, chips and cloud infrastructure fit together, the next logical step is 55 AI infrastructure stocks.

Expanding Nemotron 3.5 and partnering with Mindbeam speaks directly to the full stack AI factory catalyst, because it ties open models and CUDA centric inference more tightly to NVIDIA hardware instead of letting workloads leak to alternative stacks.

Taiwan's US$4b Texas park points to the supply and power constraints in the Narrative being addressed inside the US, which supports the thesis that NVIDIA can keep converting cloud and neocloud backlogs into shipped capacity.

itens.titulo: NVIDIA and Taiwan’s New Chip Law: The Real Risk Sits With Super Micro
itens.descricao: NVIDIA and Taiwan’s New Chip Law: The Real Risk Sits With Super Micro Yahoo Finance
trechos: NVIDIA (NVDA) picked up a new China headache on Friday, October 16, though not one that touches its guidance.
That gap showed up in August, when prosecutors indicted nine people over 74 Nvidia B300 servers that allegedly reached Chinese buyers.
In the US, prosecutors charged Super Micro co-founder Wally Liaw in March over about $2.5 billion of Nvidia servers allegedly routed to China.
Nvidia's China Line Was Already Shrinking China (including Hong Kong) revenue fell from $5.53 billion in the January 2025 quarter to $2.77 billion by July 2025, about 6% of the total.
It hit $10.16 billion in the July 2025 quarter, about 22% of revenue and up 151% in five quarters, while total revenue rose 79%.
Starting with the October 2025 quarter, Nvidia switched to customer headquarters and recast prior periods.
That means Singapore's disappearance and the apparent 67% jump in US revenue compare two different bases.
Like for like, China revenue fell 63% from a year earlier to $2.97 billion, while US revenue roughly doubled to $39.18 billion.

itens.titulo: What Analyst Projections for Key Metrics Reveal About Tesla (TSLA) Q3 Earnings
itens.descricao: What Analyst Projections for Key Metrics Reveal About Tesla (TSLA) Q3 Earnings Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Wall Street analysts forecast that Tesla (TSLA) will report quarterly earnings of $0.43 per share in its upcoming release, pointing to a year-over-year decline of 14%.
It is anticipated that revenues will amount to $27.79 billion, exhibiting a decrease of 1.1% compared to the year-ago quarter.
The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has undergone a downward revision of 9.4% in the past 30 days, bringing it to its present level.
According to the collective judgment of analysts, 'Revenues- Automotive sales' should come in at $19.89 billion.
The estimate indicates a change of -2.3% from the prior-year quarter.
Analysts forecast 'Revenues- Energy generation and storage' to reach $3.77 billion.
The estimate indicates a year-over-year change of +10.5%.
The consensus estimate for 'Revenues- Services and other' stands at $4.33 billion.
